subject: Post-call: BrightPay capacity profile + renewal rate options
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@brightpay.co>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@brightpay.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & budget range

Hi Emma / Oliver — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can prepare the renewal/expansion scenarios: 

- Current monthly usage (prod routes): ~18M tokens/day (avg) across payroll-summary and benefits-chat. You mentioned seasonal spikes in Nov/Dec.
- Near-term forecast you gave on the call: 18M -> 25M tok/day over next 6 months (roughly ~750M monthly peak).
- Primary asks for us: please confirm (a) expected steady-state monthly tokens, (b) target annual budget range for inference, and (c) any hard target for unit economics — e.g., target $/1M tokens you want us to hit for renewal.

Why this matters: we want to propose renewal pricing with step-ups and blended rates that match your traffic profile (steady + spikes), and call out where caching/KV savings could materially reduce net tokens. 

Attachments: I ran a preliminary model and attached a lightweight workbook (redwood-pricing-model.xlsx) with a few blended scenarios & assumptions. Could you confirm whether finance prefers blended pricing by monthly band or a stepped commit model?

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm steady-state / peak monthly tokens and target $/1M by EOD Wed (8/26).
- I’ll send 2-3 renewal scenarios (blended / stepped / commit + burst) for your review — call to align week of Aug 31.

If you prefer, we can also stage the renewal so only routes A (payroll-summary) are on the lower committed tier and exploratory models remain on demand.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Li <emma.li@brightpay.co>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@brightpay.co>, Procurement <procurement@brightpay.co>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & budget range

Hi Laura — thanks for the summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Current steady-state: ~520M tokens / month (average July baseline). Peak (Nov/Dec) ~820M/mo.
- Forecasting growth: we expect 15–20% lift QoQ, which aligns with your 25M/day call estimate.
- Budget guidance: our financing team is targeting $55k–$75k / month for inference in FY27 (applies to both production and supported experimental routes). That translates loosely to a target of ~$65–$95 per 1M tokens depending on how many tokens we can get offloaded to caching.

Request: would appreciate concrete blended examples that show effective $/1M under (A) a stepped commit with 3 bands, and (B) a blended single-rate offer that applies a heavier discount after a 6-month ramp. Also include notes for adding new routes/models (we may add benefits-recommendation in Q4).

Can you share the models in PDF form as well? Procurement prefers a short summary before we escalate to finance.

Best — Emma
Emma Li
Head of Product, BrightPay
emma.li@brightpay.co

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@brightpay.co>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@brightpay.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & budget range

Emma — thanks, that range is really helpful. I put together three concise scenarios (attached also as bp-scenario-summary.pdf) that map to your asks. High level first, then the numbers: 

Scenario A — Stepped commit (3 bands)
- Bands: 0–200M, 200M–600M, 600M+ per month
- Rates: $180 /1M, $120 /1M, $70 /1M
- Effective blended price at your projected steady-state (520M): ~ $116 /1M
- Notes: Best for predictable savings and protects you during Nov/Dec spikes with burst capacity at on-demand rates.

Scenario B — Blended single-rate with 6-month ramp
- Year 1 blended entry: $150 /1M; after 6 months and hitting committed thresholds, reduces to $95 /1M for remainder
- Effective blended price at steady-state: ~$122 /1M (front-loaded)
- Notes: Simpler billing; requires a 6-month usage cadence commitment to hit lower rate.

Scenario C — Commit + Route-level differentiation
- Commit for payroll-summary and benefits-chat at $90 /1M up to 600M; exploratory routes (recommendation, experiments) on-demand at $230 /1M
- Effective blended at your projected mix (80% core, 20% exploratory): ~$120 /1M
- Notes: This protects experimental budgets while giving predictable economics for the revenue-critical routes.

Additional considerations:
- Caching/KV: if you enable prefix caching on payroll-summary (expected 20–35% token reduction), your effective $/1M improves materially — I included a column in the workbook for 25% and 35% cache lift.
- Model mix: switching 10% of tokens to a quantized variant reduces per-token cost ~12% in operational spend (we account for this in Scenario C).

Attached: bp-scenario-summary.pdf (one-page summary) and I updated the workbook redwood-pricing-model.xlsx.

Next steps: 
1) I’ll prepare a short PDF you can share with Procurement & Finance. (attached)
2) If you’re comfortable with Scenario C as a starting point, I’ll loop in Rishi for approval to extend the renewal discount and then route a draft SOW/DocuSign to you.

HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 — I’ve added the scenarios there for visibility.

-Let me know which scenario you want to pilot.

Regards,
Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-24T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: approval to offer Scenario C for BrightPay renewal (deal BP-2026-Q3-RNW)

Rishi / Monica — looping you in to approve a route-differentiated blended renewal for BrightPay. Key points:
- Proposal: Scenario C (commit on core routes at $90 /1M up to 600M; exploratory on-demand at $230 /1M). Effective blended ~ $120 /1M at their forecast.
- Rationale: protects core revenue, lets BrightPay add new routes without long-term exposure, preserves margin vs giving a flat deep discount.
- Attachments: bp-scenario-summary.pdf, redwood-pricing-model.xlsx (pricing math included).

If you’re good, I’ll send the SOW + DocuSign link to Emma & Procure and apply the approved discount code on the renewal.

Thanks — Laura

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Emma Li <emma.li@brightpay.co>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@brightpay.co>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: approval to offer Scenario C for BrightPay renewal (deal BP-2026-Q3-RNW)

Laura / team / Emma — I reviewed Scenario C and approve the pricing outline. A couple of operational notes before we finalize: 

- Offer a 3% one-time onboarding credit on the first invoice (to smooth the month 1 cost); apply the approved discount code RW-BP-2026-APPROVED.
- Finance wants a short SOW with explicit bands and a clause for capacity step-ups; Monica, can you shepherd the SOW and procurement outreach?

Emma — looping you in publicly so Procurement has the internal sign-off signal. Once we have SOW + DocuSign, we can lock rates and start the 6-month ramp.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
